name: Visual Art Literacy Training (VALT)
what_you_do: A 10 week drawing and design course taught by working artists. Finishing one session lets you interview for paid JXTALabs apprenticeships, which start at age 14.
duration: About 10 weeks per session. Fall 2026: Sept 16 to Nov 20. Winter: Jan 6 to Mar 12, 2027.
deadline_text: Sessions: fall Sept 16 to Nov 20, 2026 and winter Jan 6 to Mar 12, 2027 (Tue and Thu, 4:00 to 6:30 pm). Summer 2026 ran June 23 to Aug 27.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Program Registration Form. Send questions to VALT@juxtaposition.org.
